plugin.note: Nuclear smoke devil uses the same Smoke devil Ice Barrage and cannon guide, with extra attention to the superior spawn. Keep facemask or Slayer helmet equipped and Protect from Missiles active.

requirements: Bigger and Badder unlock for 50 Slayer reward points
Facemask or Slayer helmet for smoke protection
94 Magic for Ice Barrage; Ice Burst can be used at lower Magic
Dwarf multicannon and cannonballs for efficient grouping
mechanics: Nuclear smoke devil is the superior variant of the Smoke devil.
It can spawn after a Smoke devil dies when Bigger and Badder is unlocked.
It attacks with magical ranged and is handled with the same smoke protection and Protect from Missiles plan as normal Smoke devils.
It has 240 Hitpoints, high Defence, very high magic defence bonus, and a 20% Air elemental weakness.
Superior slayer monsters always roll three additional items, with only one roll eligible for the superior unique table.

methods.label: Requirements and transportation
methods.summary: Use the normal Smoke devil route and supplies, with Bigger and Badder unlocked for superior spawns.
steps: Bank at Castle Wars and run south-west to the Smoke Devil Dungeon entrance, or use fairy ring BKP.
Equip a facemask or Slayer helmet before combat.
Place the cannon in the main room as normal; the superior appears from regular Smoke devil kills.
Keep a teleport and restoration route available because the superior has much higher stats than the regular monster.

methods.label: Smoke protection
methods.summary: Keep smoke protection and Protect from Missiles active during the superior spawn.
steps: Keep Protect from Missiles active because Nuclear smoke devil uses magical ranged.
Keep the facemask or Slayer helmet equipped throughout the kill.
Avoid misclicking rune full helm drops or unequipping the Slayer helmet while the superior is active.
Eat or teleport if the spawn disrupts the barrage stack and multiple monsters are attacking.

methods.label: Cannon barrage grouping
methods.summary: Continue the normal cannon and barrage setup, focusing the superior when it appears.
steps: Keep the cannon in the centre of the room and maintain the grouped stack around the skeleton to the west.
When a Nuclear smoke devil spawns, keep Protect from Missiles and face protection active.
Continue using Ice Barrage or Ice Burst; the superior has a 20% Air elemental weakness but the normal guide remains Magic-focused.
Rebuild the stack after the superior dies if the fight split the lured Smoke devils.
risks: The superior has much higher Defence and max hit than regular Smoke devils.
Losing prayer or face protection during the superior spawn is dangerous.

methods.label: Magic equipment
methods.summary: Use the same Ancient Magicks autocast and magic-damage equipment as the regular Smoke devil guide.
steps: Use Kodai wand where available because it can autocast Ancient Magicks, gives +15% magic damage, provides infinite water runes, and can save runes.
Use Volatile nightmare staff, Nightmare staff, Dragon hunter wand, Ancient sceptre, Blue moon spear, or Accursed sceptre as downgrade paths.
Use Slayer helmet (i) on task, or a facemask only when not using the helmet.
Use Virtus, Ancestral, Ahrim's, Dagon'hai, or Infinity robes based on budget.
Prefer Bracelet of slaughter for task-length and Slayer experience goals.

methods.label: Superior handling
methods.summary: Treat the Nuclear smoke devil as a high-value superior spawn during normal barrage tasks.
recommendedFor: Players with Bigger and Badder unlocked
requiredOrKeyItems: High-healing food if not fully comfortable
steps: When a Nuclear smoke devil spawns, keep it under Protect from Missiles and continue attacking with Magic.
Prioritise finishing the superior because it has valuable superior-table rolls and high Slayer XP.
Keep enough prayer points for the full superior kill.
Teleport if face protection or prayer mistakes put the account at risk.
After the superior dies, resume the normal cannon-barrage grouping method.
risks: The superior's high Defence can make the kill much longer than a regular Smoke devil.
The regular stack can still pressure the player if prayer drops.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Carry the same barrage inventory while preserving space for superior-table drops.
inventory: Saturated heart or other Magic boost
Rune pouch with water, blood, and death runes
Teleport to house or ring of dueling
steps: Bring enough cannonballs and runes for regular kills plus possible superior spawns.
Keep space for imbued heart, eternal gem, occult necklace, and other superior-table drops.
Use Bracelet of slaughter to increase regular kill count and therefore superior spawn opportunities.
Bank when supplies are too low to safely handle a Nuclear smoke devil spawn.

styleOptions.label: Ice Barrage cannon
styleOptions.summary: Kodai wand or other Ancient Magicks autocast staff with cannon grouping.

styleOptions.label: Ice Burst budget
styleOptions.summary: Lower-Magic version of the same cannon grouping method using Ice Burst.

styleOptions.label: Ranged lure ironman
styleOptions.summary: Manual ranged lure with a weapon such as Magic shortbow; slower and mainly useful for some ironman accounts.

body:
# Nuclear smoke devil

Superior Smoke devil variant. Use the same Ice Barrage or Ice Burst cannon method as regular Smoke devils, but preserve prayer, face protection, and teleport safety for the longer superior kill.
